title: Manta Opens Platform to Independent Creators, Launches Program for Users Who Unlocked Episodes on Tapas to Rebuild Library on Platform
content: The platform, operated by RIDI , will introduce a new section dedicated to independent creators. Creators will be able to set up profiles, upload episodes through a creator studio, and publish their work directly. Readers will be able to discover new series, leave comments, and interact with creators.
author: ANN

title: Ys VIII: Lacrimosa Of Dana Game Gets Switch 2 Release on February 25
content: NIS America announced on Tuesday that Nihon Falcom's Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of DANA action role-playing game will get a Nintendo Switch 2 release on February 25, 2027. The Switch 2 version will have a framerate of up to 120 fps and will allow co-op play for two players via GameShare.
author: ANN

title: OceanVeil to Stream Korean-Animated Boys-Love Series One-Room TA on November 13
content: OceanVeil announced on October 6 it will begin streaming the Korean-animated boys-love series One-Room TA on November 13 at 10:00 a.m. PST (1:00 p.m. EST). The series marks the platform's first Korean animation acquisition as it expands beyond Japanese anime.
author: ANN

title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Light Novels' 10th Volume Teases Finale
content: Kodansha is listing the 10th volume of Nana Mikoshiba 's The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ( Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu - Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru ) light novel series with a blurb teasing a story finale. The volume will ship on December 2.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Reveals The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2's English Dub Cast, Staff, Debut Date
content: Crunchyroll announced the cast and staff members for the English dub of the second anime season based on Nigojū and Umibōzu 's The Detective Is Already Dead ( Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. ) light novel series on Monday. The English dub of the first episode premieres on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Wuxiaworld Founder Buys Back Web Fiction Platform From Tapas
content: WuxiaWorld founder and original owner Ren (RWX) announced he has bought back the English-language web fiction platform from Tapas Entertainment , returning the company to independent ownership nearly five years after Kakao Entertainment acquired it.
author: ANN

title: Haikyu!! ALL Challengers Training Simulation Mobile Game Streams New Video
content: The official website for TOHO Games and G2Studios' Haikyu!! ALL Challengers, the first training simulation smartphone game based on the Haikyu!! anime, presented the game's new promotional video and main visual on Tuesday. Pre-registration for the game on iOS and Android is ongoing.
author: ANN

title: Light Novel 'Maou 2099' Concludes with 6th Volume
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of Kadokawa's Fantasia Bunko label announced on Tuesday that Daigo Murasaki 's Maou 2099 ( Demon Lord 2099 ) light novel will end with its sixth volume. Murasaki won the Grand Prize at the 33rd Fantasia Taisho with the title Ken to Maou no Cyberpunk in 2020.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Screen, Voice Actor Hiroshi Tsuchida Dies at 54
content: Talent agency 81 Produce announced on Tuesday that screen and voice actor Hiroshi Tsuchida died on October 11 due to heart failure. He was 54. A private funeral service was held with only close relatives in attendance, in accordance with the family's wishes. Tsuchida was born in Tokyo on February 8, 1972.
author: ANN

title: Cygames Cancels Uma Musume: Pretty Derby Franchise's U.S. Concerts
content: The staff for Cygames ' Uma Musume Pretty Derby franchise announced on Monday the cancellation of the Uma Musume: Pretty Derby – 7th Event World Tour: The Stage concerts in Los Angeles, scheduled for October 22-23.
author: ANN
